residences.note: Head, 42, born Italy, naturalized, owned home ($1,700); car repairer for a railroad company; wife Josephine 35; Vito, Carmella, Marie. [R4-S1]

bio: Nicola Castellano, known in America as Nicholas, was born in Italy about 1898 and became a naturalized citizen of the United States. In 1940 he was 42, owned the family home at 1003 Bunker Hill Street in Scranton and worked as a car repairer for a railroad company. Records give his death as 1982; in any case he died before his wife Josephine, who died in Phoenix in 1995.

researchNotes: In 1940 Nicholas Castellano, 42, born in Italy and naturalized, owned 1003 Bunker Hill Street and worked as a railroad car repairer ([R4-S1]). He had died before his wife Josephine, who died in Phoenix in 1995 and was not survived by a husband ([R4-S2]). FamilySearch gives him 1898–1982.
summary: Nicholas Castellano, an Italian-born railroad car repairer of Bunker Hill Street, Scranton, and husband of Josephine.
